author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at NetNut, a botnet claimed by Google and the Feds to be sitting inside the homes of users of cheap Android TV boxes running malware without their knowledge. This has been silently sitting in homes for two years and yesterday it got exposed and shut down by the cops. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Your Home Network Might Be Hacked Right Now...
